rationale: Price is sitting at 77.4% of today's range with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, indecisive oscillation between $41.78 and $41.90 — no clear directional momentum in either direction. The broader market is under pressure (SPY -2%, VIXY +4%), yet APG has recovered from its session low and is trading above VWAP and the 9-EMA, creating conflicting signals for both a long continuation and a short fade. With ATR of only $0.155 on 5-minute bars and the spread consuming a meaningful portion of any small move, the risk/reward for a directional bet is insufficient to justify committing capital here.
